name: content
about: A pack with all a game brings (kinds of comfort, trades, recipes, animals, dials, weights) makes a society whose dials start where the pack set them. A dial is set for the world, kept by a save, and reset to the pack's own, not the core's. A pack that names what it lacks is refused with everything wrong with it.

steps.note: a pack whose recipe, animal, trade and dial name what isn't there: refused, the society kept

Pack.why: no trade called "merchant", which the core needs; recipe 0 ("minecraft:glass"): no good called "minecraft:glass" to make; animal 0 ("cow"): no good called "minecraft:hay" to feed it; dial 2 ("no_such_dial"): no dial called no_such_dial

steps.note: every dial, the pack's two set
